title: Rebill Credits on C&I Bill Lines: Lookback and Desk Authority
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - correcting a bill line.**

## Clauses in force

1. A C&I line may be corrected only when the customer disputes it no later than the dispute lookback after the line was posted: 24 calendar months on every Beacon Ridge C&I structure.
2. The lookback ends on the same day of the month 24 months after the posted date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. A dispute raised on that last day is within the lookback.
3. Each billed C&I line may be corrected only once.
4. A care agent may post a rebill credit up to the agent adjustment limit per line, $500.00 on every structure; a larger correction is outside care-desk authority, is not posted, and is handed to a human representative with the reason that the request is not covered by policy.
5. Tag revisions by the grid operator and interval data corrections by the utility are not billing errors.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause that an over-billed line is returned as one rebill credit tied to that line, equal to the billed amount less the correctly computed amount and posted as a negative amount, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Lookback boundary (hypothetical posted dates)

| Line posted | Last day of the lookback | Dispute raised on that day | Dispute raised the next day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2026 | within | outside |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2026, there being no 29 February in 2026 | within | outside |
| 15 January 2025 | 15 January 2027 | within | outside |

## Desk authority (hypothetical corrections on one line)

| Correction on the line | Care desk |
|---|---|
| $480.00 | may post |
| $500.00 | may post |
| $500.01 | not posted; handed to a human representative as not covered by policy |

## Evidence

The posted date is read from the bill line itself, and the line corrected is the one identified by its reference number; a line that already carries a rebill credit is not corrected again.

superseded_clauses: When a C&I line was billed at more than the contract allows, the over-billed amount is returned as one rebill_credit tied to that line through source_billing_id, equal to the billed amount_usd minus the correctly computed amount and posted as a negative amount.
